design.notes: Matrix (booklet) item sampling; southern-hemisphere systems tested in late 2018. One sidecar per cycle; participating countries are store sub-jurisdictions from IDCNTRY.

enrollment.note: SCIENCE is part of the TIMSS 2019 cycle but is out of first-pass cutscore scope (MATHEMATICS only). The same four International Benchmark points apply; they are not authored on this record.

MATHEMATICS.notes: IEA names four International Benchmarks (Low / Intermediate / High / Advanced); the floor below 400 is not an IEA label and is recorded here as Below Low so cut count = n_labels - 1. proficient_from is not an IEA designation: it is set to High (>= 550) by maintainer decision (2026-09-02) for consistency with the proficiency threshold of other four-level achievement systems in the US.

cutscores_provenance: MATHEMATICS only (maintainer first-pass). Grade 4 and grade 8 share the TIMSS International Benchmarks: Low 400, Intermediate 475, High 550, Advanced 625 (TIMSS 2019 Methods Ch. 15). TIMSS 2023 Technical Report Ch. 14 states these cut points were originally selected in TIMSS 2003 and have remained constant across cycles (Gonzalez et al., 2004); descriptions of what students can do at each point are updated each cycle. SCIENCE benchmarks are the same four points but are not filed this pass. Human promotes to reviewed (A3.4 gate).
